desc: This publication is an STU update (version 2.1.0) of the STU release 2.0.0. It removes the attachment section of the Composition, adds a status reason, reference range comparators and further reference targets, corrects several profiles and invariants, aligns the model mappings with version 1.0.0 of the Xt-EHR EHDS logical models, and updates the dependencies to HL7 Europe Base 2.0.1 and Extensions 1.3.1. Some of these changes make instances that were valid under 2.0.0 invalid; the change log marks them.
